komiks.text: Original character art for a Filipino noir detective game. Tall portrait canvas 2:3 (1024x1536). Full body, FRONT view, standing straight and facing the viewer, arms relaxed at the sides, the whole figure visible from the top of the head to the shoes. Top of the head about 4% below the top edge, shoes touching the bottom edge, centered. The head is about one sixth of the total height. The character: Inspector Mateo Reyes, the hero: Filipino police detective, early 30s, lean, tan skin, messy wavy black hair, light stubble, square jaw, sharp determined dark eyes; cream embroidered barong-style shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, dark trousers, brown shoes, a police badge clipped to his belt. Expression: calm and neutral, mouth closed. Style: original Filipino komiks / webtoon noir illustration. Bold clean ink outlines in dark brown-black (#17110d), flat cel shading with 2 tones per colour, light from the top-left, muted warm noir palette (sepia, navy, deep red, mustard, cream), slightly stylized proportions, simple readable shapes. NO photorealism, NO blur, NO glow on the subject, NO gradients on the subject, NO text, NO letters, NO watermark, NO signature. The background is one flat solid colour, pure green #00FF00, filling every pixel that is not the subject: no floor, no shadow, no frame, no text, no watermark. Do not use any green colour in the subject itself.
